propositions: Ubuntu Verified jobs occupy 11-14 minutes per run (1,812 runner-seconds baseline) and contribute to queue contention without corresponding test coverage uniqueness.

Bridge cadence test invokes YAML parsing 1,440 times redundantly within a comprehension; hoisting the parsed schedule eliminates ~5.7 runner-minutes per run while preserving exhaustive minute arithmetic.

Pandoc corpus and hardening suites execute 3,421+ real Pandoc subprocesses to assert only cardinality/existence; replacing redundant legacy execution with immutable golden outputs preserves all 884 product conversions while eliminating 883 duplicate processes.

AST provenance fixture setup spends 46–49 seconds rediscovering caller/parent relationships on every run; caching indices as single-build operations reduces this phase without changing assertion semantics.

Static policy invocation (complexity-baseline) runs identically in all four matrix cells (52–55s per cell, 154s total) and should execute once in the lint job rather than multiply, saving ~2.57 runner-minutes per run.

End-to-end Verify wall time remains 22–32 minutes after targeted per-test and per-phase remediations, with macOS job duration as the critical path; distributed suite throughput rather than individual long-pole tests dominates remaining latency.
